name: Opsgenie
label: Opsgenie REST API
description: Opsgenie REST API via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://docs.opsgenie.com/docs/api-overview. Atlassian end of support is 2027-04-05 (REST APIs remain until then; migrate to Jira Service Management or Compass Operations APIs). Operations: alert_create, alert_get, alert_ack, alert_close, alert_note, incident_create, schedule_oncall, heartbeat_ping, listen. Auth secret api_key is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). listen/trigger are kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Failures are output.error. JDK HTTP, official API only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: alert_create | alert_get | alert_ack | alert_close | alert_note | incident_create | schedule_oncall | heartbeat_ping | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'alert_create'.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Request-body parameter `description` for operations: alert_create, incident_create.

schema.label: priority
schema.description: Request-body parameter `priority` for operations: alert_create, incident_create.

schema.label: visibleTo
schema.description: alert_create teams/users who can see the alert. [{type, id|name}].

schema.label: identifierType
schema.description: Query-string parameter `identifierType` for operations: alert_get, alert_ack, alert_close, alert_note.

schema.label: note
schema.description: Free-text note for alert_note (required), alert_ack, alert_close, alert_create and incident_create. Max 25000 characters. Example: Restarted the payment worker.

schema.label: api_region
schema.description: Opsgenie API region host. EXACT: api.opsgenie.com (US) | api.eu.opsgenie.com (EU). Example: api.eu.opsgenie.com.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: alert_create, alert_get, alert_ack, alert_close, alert_note, incident_create, schedule_oncall, heartbeat_ping, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Opsgenie API key. Authorization: GenieKey <key>. EU accounts also set api_host to api.eu.opsgenie.com. Product sunset 2027-04-05 — https://www.atlassian.com/software/opsgenie/migration.

configurationParameters.label: API Host
configurationParameters.description: Opsgenie API host for the account's region. EXACT: api.opsgenie.com (US, default) | api.eu.opsgenie.com (EU). Example: api.eu.opsgenie.com.

configurationParameters.label: API Region
configurationParameters.description: Opsgenie API region host. EXACT: api.opsgenie.com (US) | api.eu.opsgenie.com (EU). Example: api.eu.opsgenie.com.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).
